exact_claim: For the MONO-branch heat filter S = exp[(xi^2/2) Delta] (xi > 0; Fourier symbol m(k) = exp(-(xi^2/2)|k|^2), kernel G_xi = (2 pi xi^2)^(-3/2) exp(-|x|^2/(2 xi^2))): (i) on flat Euclidean L2(R^3, d^3x), S is a self-adjoint contraction with norm 1 (sharp: m(0)=1), analytic on every tempered class (Schwartz, Sobolev H^s all s, L^p all p, S'), with exact plane-wave action (S e^{ik .})(x) = e^{-xi^2 k^2/2} e^{ik x}, translation-invariant kernel mass sqrt(2 pi) xi, and exact semigroup law S(xi1) S(xi2) = S(sqrt(xi1^2+xi2^2)) — certified in Lean 4 with zero sorry, axioms exactly {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}; (ii) on the galactic measure dmu_N = N sqrt(h) d^3x, the correct adjoint is S*_mu = rho^{-1} S rho (rho = N sqrt(h); machine-verified 3.5e-18) and the naive S* = S fails for nonconstant lapse (gap 7.77e-3, control capable of failing); S and S*_mu are bounded with norm 1 iff rho, rho^{-1} in L^infinity (lapse bounded above and below) and unbounded on growing exponential-weight domains (measured growth ratios 443x on L10/L5 and 6.2e11x on L20/L10); (iii) the composition T(u) = S* div[(nu_mono-1) grad S u] is distributionally well-defined for every u in L2(d^3x) (indeed in S'), no differentiability required: with y = |grad S u|/a0, h_mono(y) ~ sqrt(y), the layer product (nu_mono-1) grad S u = a0 h_mono(y) e_hat is a continuous bounded field (V_ring 1.68e-11 m/s^2 vs naive (nu-1) bound 31.3; V = a0 h(.) e_hat exact to 0.0 residual), so T is a C^infinity-distribution; both footings a0 = 9.3619e-11 and 1.1279e-10 m/s^2 enter only through the y-normalization (V/a0 = 0.180 and 0.149; identity statements are a0-free and G-free; G_N/G_bare/G_cosmo kept separate). Numeric residuals: multiplier 2.36e-16, symbol-vs-direct 2.2e-16, flat adjoint gap 6.9e-18, galactic adjoint gap 3.5e-18, layer cancellation max|T| 3.0e-52 (all actual outputs from audit_heat_filter_domain.out).

new_assumptions: Spline-free: kernel normalization (2 pi xi^2)^(-1/2) in 1D fibre is the explicit normalization used in the certified multiplier identity (heat kernel/unit-mass interpretation; matches AS043).
Galactic pairing convention: adjoint taken with respect to dmu_N = N sqrt(h) d^3x (rho = N sqrt(h)); S*_mu = M_{1/rho} S M_rho.

Lapse-boundedness criterion: S*_mu bounded on L2(dmu_N) iff rho and rho^{-1} are in L^infinity over the support; adopted for the audit's boxed domain (not yet tied to the physical AS205 lapse profile).
Weighted-space certificates: for w = 1 + x^2, Sw = w + xi^2 exactly in 1D; norm bound sqrt(1+xi^2) on L2(w dx).
The interior of the boundary of the box is noise-excluded (|x| > 1e-12 ring cut) for the layer controls; the zero set of grad S u is the singular set.
